newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: bauMAX lowers 1996 net profit forecast.
newsitem.headline: bauMAX lowers 1996 net profit forecast.

text.p: bauMAX AG, Austria's leader in the do-it-yourself sector, said on Wednesday it expected 1996 group net profit to match last year's 211.7 million schillings, adding it expected to pay an unchanged 19 schilling dividend.
The forecast is a downward revision of its earlier expectations of a 225 million schilling net profit.
In an earlier press statement released ahead of its earnings conference, bauMAX also revised down its forecast for full-year sales to 7.2 billion schillings from its initial forecast of 7.5 billion.
In 1995, the company posted sales of 6.8 billion.
For the first six months of the year, bauMAX said group net profit slipped 0.35 percent from the year-ago period and pre-tax profit fell 11.7 percent. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 254
